governance.acceptance_policy: No gate is self-accepted. DONE means implementation complete and pending independent CMOS review.
governance.claim_policy: Measured facts, documentary facts, academic hypotheses, analogies and myths remain separated. Mathematical compatibility is not historical truth.

current_gate.title: Width-interval undercoverage diagnosis
current_gate.objective: Diagnose the frozen M6 width coverage failure without changing the seed, case set or preregistered threshold; distinguish finite-sample variation, interval approximation and implementation error.
required_outputs: coverage confidence interval and expected finite-sample variability
decision: implementation defect, calibration revision, or statistically plausible miss
